svg.title: OmniRoute free-tier budget: about 1.62 billion free tokens per month steady, up to about 2.22 billion in the first month with signup credits. The catalog contains 466 rows, 458 active and 8 discontinued, grouped into 34 recurring pool keys; 17 pools have a published positive monthly token budget and 17 have a zero, uncapped, or keyless budget. Honest pool-deduped math counts each shared free pool once; 12 providers carry a terms-of-service avoid flag. The 17 quantified pools plus five per-model Groq caps are Mistral 1 billion, NaraRouter 210 million, LLM7.io 150 million, xKiro 150 million, Groq 30 million across five per-model caps, Cloudflare Workers AI 30 million, Api.airforce 24 million, BluesMinds 7.2 million, SambaNova 6 million, Arcee AI 4.8 million, NavyAI 4.5 million, BazaarLink 3.6 million, OpenRouter 1.2 million, Cohere 800 thousand, HuggingChat 500 thousand, Morph 400 thousand, HuggingFace 200 thousand, Kiro AI 25 thousand. One-time signup credits add about 601 million. Uncapped providers and the OpenRouter top-up boost are shown separately so they do not inflate the headline. A further 6 million behind regional identity verification (ModelScope) is also shown apart. Live usage remains available at /dashboard/free-tiers.
svg.desc: Pool-deduplicated chart of the 17 recurring free-token pools with positive published budgets (plus Groq's five per-model caps as one segment), plus signup credits and uncapped providers shown separately.
